title: galium palustre f. rupicola
intro: Galium palustre f. rupicola, commonly known as the alpine bedstraw, is a variant of the Galium palustre plant species that is native to mountainous regions. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Galium palustre f. rupicola include soothing and calming effects on the nervous system, as well as its ability to support the body's natural healing processes. The bioactive constituents of Galium palustre f. rupicola include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
